output.title: OperatorHub discontinuation does not affect this Helm-based install
output.content: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages, with v1.16.5 the last release there. The environment's installed products show cert-manager installed from the cert-manager Helm chart via a Flux HelmRelease, an Argo CD Application and helmfile, not via OperatorHub. The installation path shown is not affected.
